limitations: Final frozen R06 package is an unaccepted structural candidate. Seven real original commits contain six model stages R01-R06; the last commit adds completion records, renders, QA and source evidence and is neither a seventh model stage nor another new scene.

All four source views remain FAILED. References are attributed 1192x671 article screenshots, not native decoded frames; exact clip timestamps and highest decodable video quality remain unknown. Later-date cover evidence supports only local reuse, not unchanged full geometry or native independent views.

All original R01-R05 stages and failures remain reachable and archived, including R02/R03 wall-mapping defects and rejected outside-hall low-residual camera trials. The final R06 four models are unchanged by the completion-record commit.

Frozen CURRENT.json identifies four editable R06 material/white BLEND and GLB originals. Archive checks their recorded bytes and SHA256, not model acceptance. Producer QA reports 215 meshes and 13 cameras, finite aperture and reimport checks; those tests do not prove full-shell validity, whole-scene support or source matching.

Twenty-eight formal renders comprise 26 base images plus two higher-sample views of the same main camera, not extra source angles. Eight direct 50-percent overlays, three article-image relative-depth result sets and independent QA are retained. Overlay arithmetic agreement does not mean source-to-model geometric agreement.

Eight model-check angles per material are diagnostic only; cropping, occlusion, unseen undersides and roof interiors remain limitations. Relative inverse depth is not metric geometry and retains mirror, effect, dark-region and background failures.

R06 star/ring and camera changes remain conditional hypotheses. Training-point residuals still exceed the original marking bound, full-circle window count and hidden layout are unconfirmed, and PBR proxies/GLB exports do not reproduce the full Blender lighting or world. Historical reports and later QA appendices are preserved verbatim.

Archive worker only materializes supported input, checks all file bytes and Git objects, preserves real history and performs normal Git commits/pushes and independent remote readback. No modeling, rendering, source-script execution, production-worktree changes, credential copying, LFS, force push, main changes, Issues or PRs.

The separately blocked source-screening receipt stays paused and is not retried or included in this observatory publication. All Library temporaries and permanent attachments remain untouched by cleanup.
